addressGoes: in X's developer console, as a webhook subscribed to post.mention.create, dm.received and dm.sent
notes: **A reply to a public mention** is a post, and X takes 280 characters in one, as X counts them, on an account without Premium. The adapter sends a longer answer whole and X refuses it: keep the agent's public answers short, or have it answer in direct messages, which take 10,000.

why.maxTextLength: The adapter sends a message's text whole, whatever its length (sendDm, sendReply), and X refuses a direct message over 10,000 characters, so the whole reply would be lost. A public reply is shorter still: 280 characters, as X counts them, on an account without Premium. This one number is the direct message's.
why.addressGoes: The adapter makes no call that registers a webhook. Its README has it done once in the console (console.x.com), which then sends the CRC check the adapter answers; the Activity API can do the same (POST /2/webhooks, then POST /2/activity/subscriptions), but with a different kind of sign-in for each call.
why.notes: sendReply posts the text whole. 280 is X's limit for a post, from X's documentation and not the adapter: only direct messages are stood in for in the tests.
